note: SE-F-049 — the test gate (scripts/check-tests.js) refuses any jest run where a suite SKIPS at the suite level. test:gate runs after `npm run build`, so the dist-gated e2e/gateway/cli suites always run; a suite-level skip means either the build step vanished from the pipeline or a new describe.skip guard was added silently. Individual TEST skips (environment-probed, e.g. the win32 case) are a different, honest category and are not counted here. Raising this number requires a recorded reason next to the change. Budget is 1 (2026-10-23) for local runs without the sibling consumer repository: src/core/config/structuredAiContract.test.ts and src/ai/mcp/mcpIndexGeneration.test.ts are cross-repo contract tests and skip when STRUCTURED_AI_ROOT (the consumer's structured-ai folder) is not set and no monorepo-layout sibling exists. CI checks the consumer repository out read-only and runs with SEMANTIC_ENGINE_SKIP_BUDGET=0, so there every suite must run. The consumer repository is never modified.
